round_note: Stocking-stuffer season starts now: Holiday Beauty Event favorites, small gifts for kids, dogs and travelers, and the everyday best sellers that keep moving.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and one of Amazon's most-gifted devices every holiday season.

picks.name: Anker Nano Power Bank
picks.why: Pocket-size charger with a built-in connector, so there's no cable to forget. A favorite stocking stuffer.
picks.query: Anker Nano Power Bank built-in connector

picks.name: Amazon Smart Plug (2-Pack)
picks.why: Puts holiday lights and lamps on a schedule or Alexa voice control. One of the most-reviewed smart home items on Amazon.

picks.name: COSRX Acne Pimple Patches (240 Count)
picks.why: Hydrocolloid patches that flatten breakouts overnight. A big multi-pack featured in Amazon's Holiday Beauty Event.
picks.query: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch 240 count

picks.name: Burt's Bees Overnight Intensive Lip Treatment

picks.query: Burt's Bees Original Overnight Intensive Lip Treatment

picks.name: Medicube Toner Pads
picks.why: K-beauty toner pads that were among the best-selling skincare of October. A quick, no-mess way to prep skin.

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Glowy Balm

picks.name: Lysol Disinfecting Wipes (4-Pack)

picks.name: KitchenAid Silicone Oven Mitts (2-Pack)

picks.query: KitchenAid Ribbed Soft Silicone Oven Mitt 2 pack

picks.name: Tony's Chocolonely Chocolate Bar Pack

picks.query: Tony's Chocolonely chocolate bar variety pack 6

picks.query: EverFoams women's fuzzy memory foam slippers

picks.name: Owala FreeSip 40 oz Water Bottle

picks.query: Owala FreeSip 40 oz stainless steel water bottle

picks.name: LifeStraw Personal Water Filter
picks.why: A portable straw filter for hikers and travelers. A long-time Amazon favorite and a useful small gift.

picks.query: Bocce's Bakery 12 day advent calendar for dogs
